| Violation | Impact | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `aria-prohibited-attr` on `#side-deals` | Serious | Removed `aria-label` from `<div>` without a role (prohibited by ARIA spec) |

| `aria-allowed-role` on editorial `<article>` elements (best-practice) | — | Removed `role="listitem"` conflicting with implicit `article` role; also removed `role="list"` and `aria-label` from the grid wrapper |

**Strategy used:** Node + Playwright + axe-core (Strategy 3 — no existing test framework). All tests run against the exact submitted artifact.
